steps.prompt_exact: I need a saveable offline visual QA board for planning reference-photo edits: let me record the reference traits, proposed changes, identity and composition details to protect, drift risks, and then copy or export a tidy change receipt.
steps.response_summary: Returned a self-contained offline Visual QA Board with localStorage, receipt generation, copy/export controls, and a dark two-column layout.

steps.prompt_exact: This works as a sketch, but the file uses inline onclick handlers, alert/confirm popups, and an https placeholder, which makes it risky as an offline QA receipt. Please return a revised single HTML file that wires buttons with addEventListener, uses an in-page status/confirm flow instead of modal APIs, and keeps all examples local/plain text.
steps.response_summary: Revised the board to use addEventListener, in-page toast/confirmation UI, local-only placeholders, and no modal APIs.
